data.name: Farboud
data.gender_notes: Farboud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Farbuh', meaning 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. This name is also associated with power and strength. The name Farboud carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farboud usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the wisdom and intelligence bestowed upon an individual by Allah, and the power and strength to use this knowledge for good.
data.etymology: Farboud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farboud total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Historically, it is not a widely used name but holds significance in its meaning related to starting new endeavors. The name is of Arabic origin and is used in various Muslim cultures
